text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated error rate from tool/function calls impacting structured-output endpoints in prod. Alerting sev2. Details: spike at 11:07 UTC, ~4x normal fncall rate, increased 500s on /v1/generate (structured).

alex_oncall: on it — joining. any patient-facing impact known?

ellie_support: getting a few customer tickets about malformed JSON responses and timeouts. few on free tier, some on standard.

sam_sre: seeing KV cache pressure + backend gRPC timeouts in logs. correlation with high external agent invocations.

maya_prodeng: can we drop structured output or disable toolcall parsing as a live mitigation? need low-risk change.

alex_oncall: plan: 1) immediate soft-disable of function/tool-calls for free-tier & burst traffic 2) disable structured-output streaming for affected models 3) tighten per-tenant concurrent toolcall cap to 2.

sam_sre: agree. I'll apply a global runtime guard that converts fncalls -> placeholder message and short-circuits downstream invoke. doing it in the runtime so no deploy.

alex_oncall: @sam_sre how do we flip? share command.

sam_sre: runbook snippet:
```
# runtime guard toggle
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/v1/config/toggles \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"toggle":"runtime.fncall_soft_disable","value":"on","scope":"global"}'
```
I'll run now.

sam_sre: applied toggle at 11:12 UTC. verifying metrics.

sam_sre: metrics: fncall rate dropped ~70% within 30s, 500s on structured endpoints down ~60%. latency improved.

maya_prodeng: pushing a conservative streaming change: flip structured-output streaming -> compact-mode for affected models via console patch.

alex_oncall: @ellie_support prepare a short message for customers who report errors: "We're seeing a temporary increase in tool-invocation load which may affect structured responses. We've applied mitigations; please reach out if you still see issues."

ellie_support: drafting and posting to status page now.

deploy-bot: deploy: console-config-patch by maya_prodeng succeeded (11:15 UTC) — 1 instance rolled.

sam_sre: follow-up: applied per-tenant concurrent toolcall cap for burst tiers at 11:16 UTC. config: `tenant.toolcall.max_concurrent = 2` for plan:free,burst.

alex_oncall: monitoring for 15m. if stable, we can reopen toolcalls in tiered manner after verifying KV pressure back to baseline.

maya_prodeng: creating a temporary rate-limit rule to shape incoming requests from high-QPS tenants: `rate_limit(window=1m, limit=300)` in edge-lb for suspicious IPs.

sam_sre: logs show no new 5xx spikes. customer tickets coming down.

ellie_support: posted update to customers and status page: "Mitigations applied, we're monitoring. We'll provide another update in 30 minutes."

alex_oncall: handoff: i'm going to stay on for next 30. @sam_sre please take lead if anything regresses.

sam_sre: acknowledged. creating incident doc/summary now. tagging for postmortem: root cause unknown, hypothesis: surge in chained agent/tool invocations causing cache/GRPC overload.

maya_prodeng: action items assigned: 1) rollback soft-disable plan for tenants after 30m if stable 2) add telemetry to fncall client to detect cascades 3) QOS enforcement in runtime.

alex_oncall: closing pager for now — mitigation in place and improving. will reopen if we see increased errors. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, severity=2, mitigation=runtime fncall soft-disable + structured-output compacting + per-tenant caps. responders=@alex_oncall,@sam_sre,@maya_prodeng,@ellie_support.

ellie_support: leaving note for customers who had issues; escalation channel open.

sam_sre: saving logs and toggles to /incidents/1769501234/artifacts for postmortem.

alex_oncall: thanks everyone. short retrospective tomorrow to tighten guardrails.
